text:
anya (Marketing): tiny request  need a reusable benchmark promo pack for webinar + inbound. Single-page: headline + 1-line sub + micro-sparkline (tokens/sec vs $/k). Two messaging directions: latency-first and cost-first. Deadline: EOD Tue.

sam (Design): got it. export targets? svg + png? responsive crops?

anya (Marketing): svg + png (2x). hero desktop 1200x600, mobile 640x360, square 800x800. keep copy minimal: headline ~7 words, sub 12-15 words.

rico (Growth): include a brand-only variant (no CTA) for lift tests. Also need transparent PNG for media overlay.

sam (Design): will create 2 layouts: "stat-led" and "sentence-led". planning 2 colorways (brand blue + inverted dark). small methodology footnote area per legal. GIF for sparkline?

anya (Marketing): yes, 3-frame GIF for the sparkline (loop).

eve (Legal): avoid absolutes. use "up to" or "on typical workloads". add a tiny link to methodology. I'll review final copy.

assets-bot: uploaded draft_v1.zip to /Shared/marketing/bench-mini/draft_v1.zip

sam (Design): Figma draft: https://www.figma.com/file/zz99/bench-mini-draft — org access. I'll push mocks by tomorrow 11:30 for 12pm review.

anya (Marketing): perfect. I'll add a quick review checklist and tag stakeholders. Thanks!
